10442834.en: At this point, the image gradually dissolves into fading smoke. The unraveled spider silk also catches fire, crumbling to a few glowing embers within moments...

10442835.en: The little arachnid on your body suddenly springs to life, leaping in one swift motion onto the enemy before you. The creature is tiny and crafted with a special spell, making it nearly impossible to detect without close inspection. {name|C} remains completely unaware of the being now lurking on {gender1|C} body, walking and speaking as ordinary...

10442836.en: Ugh... why is my body itching... Huh? This feels awful... so awful! Help... help me...

10442837.en: You watch as the enemy before you scratches the head frantically, writhing in agony. Soon, your enemy convulses as if having a seizure, collapsing to the ground in violent thrashing, crying with savage howls. In mere moments, the small arachnid devours the person bit by bit, leaving only a wisp of soul. The silken being appears to have exhausted its energy as well—the intricate knots melt in an instant, leaving only a few strands of gray-white thread...

10442838.en: I must find a way to save them

10442843.en: Let the Sect Leader spare resources

10442848.en: Shall we go investigate Fallen Valley?

10442855.en: I have other matters for now

10442947.en: Ao Yao leads you wandering around, and shortly after, you both leave the sect and arrive in the wilderness.

10442948.en: The battle grows desperate, and your opponent is about to deliver the final blow. Just at that moment, air currents surge from all directions; a cyan shadow flashes before your eyes. {name|B} blocks your path and pulls you into a dimensional rift.

10442949.en: {name|B} successfully brings you away from the battlefield through the rift, yet her face reveals a deeply worried expression.

10442950.en: She abandons her usual playful expression and examines you with serious intent. After a moment, as if having made some grave resolution, she slightly loosens her upper garment and uses her little fingernail to cut the fair skin above her heart. Mystical blood immediately gushes forth like a stream, which Ao Yao collects with a vial.

10442951.en: The situation was critical just now, so I had no choice but to use the River Chart's power to bring you to the rift. Though you were only there for a moment, it has already done great harm to your body... So, take this. You can use it as a remedy if you cannot endure.

10442952.en: I... don't know why, but I'm feeling a bit tired. I'll go home and rest for a while. Come find me when you're free, alright?

10442953.en: After {name|B} cut {gender1|B} chest and bled, {gender|B} seems to have grown somewhat weak. After saying goodbye to you, {gender|B} waves {gender1|B} hand and departs.

10442954.en: You drink Ao Yao's heart blood, and your vital essence glows as if set ablaze, boiling within you. Wherever this heat flows, it seems to sweep away all the impurity within you in one cleansing wave. After a moment, you feel nothing but soothing, comfortable warmth.

10442955.en: Spare me, spare me! Fellow cultivator—no, master cultivator, please spare my life! I merely spoke ill of you in passing, and that cold, icy lady, {name|B}, pursued me riding on her sword for thousands of miles! Her entire person radiates freezing cold, and her commanding of Water arts are simply inconceivable! She's terrifying! So terrifying!

10442956.en: This is all my fault—I won't dare again! Never again! Fellow cultivator! Please accept this gift, and can we consider the matter settled? Could you please ask that lady to spare me?

10442957.en: Alas, in this world, everyone encounters their own misfortunes. Speaking of which, your {relation|C|A} seems to be in danger right now.

10442958.en: Mm, after all, they are the people who care about you most in this world. Putting in extra effort for them is always worthwhile.

10442959.en: {name|B} pauses thoughtfully after saying this, then turns to leave.

10442960.en: You're right... We truly cannot help everyone.

10442961.en: {name|B} shows a sorrowful expression. She hesitates for a moment, then waves goodbye to you and leaves.

10442962.en: For now, you are safe, but as you journey through the world hereafter, please take extra care.

10442963.en: Thank you... But why were you willing to go to such lengths to save me...

10442966.en: Sigh... I fear that someday I will leave or die, and will be unable to watch over {name|A}. When that time comes, only you family and friends will understand {gender|A} and care for {gender2|A}...

10442967.en: As {name|B} spoke, sorrow appeared on {gender1|B} usually cold, jade-like features. {gender|B} let out a sigh, said nothing more, then slowly turned and walked away into the distance.

10442968.en: Last time, I suffered grievous injuries and was on my Last Breath. I owe my life to {name|B}'s rescue, though it seems {gender|B} only intervened for your sake.

10442969.en: Therefore, I prepared a modest gift, hoping to repay {gender2|B} in my way. Unfortunately, I cannot find any trace of {name|B}. Could I ask you to deliver it on my behalf?

10442970.en: In addition, this is also a small token of my gratitude to you. If not for your friendship with extraordinary people who came to my rescue, I fear my soul would have scattered by now, and I would be nothing but a pile of bones.

10442971.en: {name|A}, someone asked me to deliver this to you. Please accept it.

10442972.en: Well, come to think of it, this is from an icy lady who wanted me to give it to you. Here's what happened.

10442973.en: Could you please deliver this to {name|A}?

10442975.en: I would only incur misfortune... bad things always happen to others once I am present, so it's better for me to avoid {name|A} as much as possible.

10442976.en: But you clearly brought good things to {gender|A}. How can you still say bad things happen to the person?

10442977.en: Sigh. I hope you will deliver this for me. Let's not speak of this anymore...

10442978.en: I still wanted to ask, but {gender|B} has left. It seems {gender|B} really cares about you. The item has been delivered, so I'll be going now.

10442979.en: It seems that person has a cold exterior but a warm heart. The item has been delivered, so I'll be going now.

10442980.en: Ahead, the Nether Demon howls wildly at the sky, while {name|B} beside you coldly observes the monster. But suddenly, her expression shifts as she reaches out to grab you, trying to pull you away. At the same moment, cracks spread across the ground in all directions, and with a thunderous rumble, you and {name|B} plummet together into the depths below.

10442981.en: {name|B} senses layers of Nether Air surrounding you, preventing free movement. She turns to check that you are unharmed, then waves her hand to send out several arachnids woven from spider silk. The moment they leave her hand, they come alive like living creatures, scurrying about in all directions before vanishing from sight.

10442982.en: I never expected that Nether Demon, though dumb as an animal, would scheme against us. Now that we're trapped underground and surrounded by Nether Air, it's unwise to take risks. I've sent out my silk-woven spiders to search for an exit. Until then, we might as well rest.

10442983.en: Having spoken, {name|B} found a clean spot and sat in meditation with closed eyes. In mere moments, she entered a state of profound tranquility, free from all thoughts and dreams.

10442984.en: What are you looking at? What's so interesting to see?

10442985.en: Though {name|B} sits in meditation with closed eyes, she knows your every movement perfectly. Without hesitation, she waves her hand and extinguishes the dim light, plunging the surroundings into complete darkness. Silence falls between you in the pitch-black darkness, creating an atmosphere charged with tension.

10442986.en: At that moment, warmth floods through your body as {name|B} draws close. Your wrist suddenly tightens as her spider silk gently binds it, while your other hand is simultaneously taken into her grasp.

10442987.en: In the darkness, you sense {name|B}'s shifting emotions flowing through the spider silk—at times restrained and controlled, at others passionate and tense, ever-changing. Through your hand flows {name|B}'s energy, sending waves of tingling sensations coursing through you. Wondrous feelings ebb and flow between both hands, and before long, you gradually drift into a realm of utter tranquility.

10442988.en: Are you awake? I've already found a way out—let's go. I'm sorry for getting you trapped in this mess.

10442989.en: {name|B} seems unwilling to let you see her expression, speaking coldly while turning her face away. By the time she finishes speaking, she has already departed into the distance.

10442990.en: You and {name|B} meditate separately, oblivious to the passage of time. But suddenly, your spiritual awareness stirs, and you sense something prompting you to open your eyes. You find {name|B} watching you with a tender, vulnerable expression—but the moment she sees you awaken, her demeanor immediately turns cold once more.

10442991.en: I've already found a safe route—let's go. This time... I got you trapped in this mess. This is my apology.

10442992.en: {name|B} turns away as she speaks. By the time she finishes, she has already departed into the distance.

10442993.en: {name|B} sees you lingering at Silken Cottage and lost in thought, but doesn't disturb you. Instead, she begins to weave silk threads quietly beside you; her hands move with ethereal power, forming intricate patterns and knots in her fingertips without pause.

10442994.en: Oh? Done with your thoughts? Here, something for you to play with.

10442995.en: You... What do you really want?

10442996.en: I want to teach you a lesson.

10442998.en: Mind your words from now on, understood?

10443007.en: Oh? What brings you here? I still have some business to take care of, hehe.
